scope: Verify the responsive mobile flex.basis Inspector route, inheritance reset, Undo/Redo, draft Save/reload, explicit Publish and desktop-value preservation.
lifecycle: Set mobile flex.basis to 42%; Canvas reflects the override.
Draft Save leaves public mobile output unchanged; Editor reload retains the draft value.
Explicit Publish updates public mobile output while desktop keeps its independent value.
Reset removes only responsive.mobile.flexBasis and restores the inherited desktop value on Canvas.
Undo restores the mobile override; Redo restores inheritance.
Draft Save/reload keeps the published mobile override live; explicit Publish applies the reset.
Published mobile inheritance matches the desktop basis without changing desktop Canvas or public output.

test_harness.change: Browser action timeout increased from 6s to 15s and navigation timeout from 12s to 30s for this existing full-layout test.
test_harness.initial_attempts: Two runs stopped before the new lifecycle assertions due pre-existing slow-navigation/click timeouts. The final run completed the full test successfully.

limitations: One property and one browser lifecycle are covered; this does not certify all Inspector properties or all 79 element types.
Physical-device acceptance remains unverified; 77.44.7.A remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED.
